study.name: Stockport railway network
study.description: 20 geographical miles from Stockport station, not a route-distance radius.

boxes.name: Edgeley Junction No. 1
boxes.description: South of Edgeley Junction No. 2, on the southern approaches to Stockport. The wider junction complex connects routes towards Hazel Grove and the Macclesfield and Crewe corridors.
boxes.historicContext: Published historical material describes Absolute Block working towards Edgeley Junction No. 2 and connections towards Hazel Grove. Detailed current lever-to-equipment mapping has not been checked.

boxes.name: Edgeley Junction No. 2
boxes.description: Located between Edgeley Junction No. 1 and Stockport No. 1, near the converging approaches south of Stockport station.
boxes.historicContext: Historical descriptions identify this box as part of the traditionally block-worked Stockport corridor. Individual current point and signal assignments are not yet verified.

boxes.name: Stockport No. 1
boxes.description: At the southern end of Stockport station. Adjacent to Stockport No. 2 across the station tracks and Edgeley Junction No. 2 to the south.
boxes.historicContext: Historical accounts describe Fast, Slow, Main and Goods routes through the station. These records do not establish the present control of each individual signal or crossover.

boxes.name: Stockport No. 2
boxes.description: At the north end of Stockport station and south end of the viaduct. A historical layout study describes Fast, Slow, Main, Goods and carriage siding routes around the box.
boxes.historicContext: The Signalling Record Society documents a detailed 1981 lever list and signal/point relationships. Those numbers must not be read as a verified current inventory; the account describes subsequent infrastructure changes.
historicalExamples: Signal 47: Down Slow starting signal (1981 record)
Points 92: Down Slow to Down Fast crossover arrangement (1981 record)

boxes.name: Heaton Norris Junction
boxes.description: North of Stockport Viaduct on the Manchester Piccadilly approach, at the junction for the Denton and Guide Bridge line.
boxes.historicContext: The published Stockport No. 2 historical study explains the four parallel line and block bell arrangements in operation in 1981. It should not be used as a definitive current signalling specification.
